title: Review semantic patch risk
objective: Identify revision or specialist-review needs after deterministic tests; never approve a production merge.

decision.instructions: Evaluate `patch` against `requirement`. What review route is justified?

criteria.ordinary_review: No obvious mismatch in the supplied patch; ordinary review still applies
criteria.revise: Patch conflicts with requirement or omits necessary behavior

scope: Advisory decision workflow. No native Codex interception or production action.
